warmup_event.log_line: Warmup: priming Metal kernels — done in 8.1s (Metal cache primed, memory cleared)
warmup_event.interpretation: Warmup primes Metal shader cache, eliminating cold-start cost for small ops (Phase 0 Smoke 8s -> 0.3s, 27x speedup). But large-scale prefills (NIAH 16K, RULER 16K k=5) still hit the slow cluster — the shader cache benefit doesn't survive the memory pressure and scale of those ops. Task 20's root-cause identification was partially correct; the fix is useful for the small-op path but doesn't address the large-op bimodal. The cumulative benefit is real though: Phase 3b got 4 more tasks in before breach (task 4 -> task 8).
